scoring_approach: Deterministic weighted scorecard centered on a baseline of 50. Scores are a prototype readiness signal, not a probability of repayment.

features.label: Inflow regularity
features.positive_reason: More weeks show qualifying inflow in this demo summary.
features.negative_reason: Fewer weeks show qualifying inflow in this demo summary.

features.label: Income volatility
features.positive_reason: Income changes less sharply across the observed demo months.
features.negative_reason: Income changes more sharply across the observed demo months.

features.label: Bill punctuality
features.positive_reason: Selected recurring bills are more often on time in this demo summary.
features.negative_reason: Selected recurring bills are less often on time in this demo summary.

features.label: Supplier-payment consistency
features.positive_reason: Declared business payments follow a more consistent pattern in this demo summary.
features.negative_reason: Declared business payments follow a less consistent pattern in this demo summary.

features.label: Balance buffer
features.positive_reason: The demo summary shows more days of typical-outflow buffer.
features.negative_reason: The demo summary shows fewer days of typical-outflow buffer.

exclusions: No raw transaction narratives, bank credentials, contacts, SMS, call logs, location, photos, protected attributes, or credit-bureau file.
Data coverage affects evidence confidence only; a missing feature is not silently treated as zero.
limitations: The feature values, weights, and personas are synthetic and illustrative.
This model is not trained or validated to predict default or repayment.
The output cannot make a lending, pricing, KYC, collection, or fraud decision.
test_summary: Golden fixtures verify reproducible score output.
Boundary tests keep the score within 0-100.
Monotonicity tests verify that a beneficial observed change does not lower the prototype score.
